subject: Accelerated MAP & signature runway for NovaMed pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@novamed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novamed.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + timeline for signature - Redwood pilot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (NovaMed_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) so procurement and legal can align on a condensed runway. Our internal target is signature for MSA + DPA + Order Form by 2027-06-10 to hit the pilot kickoff on 6/20.

Top constraints on our side: vendor SOC2 evidence (must be available for review by 6/03), DPA review tied to data residency clauses, and procurement needs an order form that shows billing cadence and the initial committed capacity.

Can Redwood confirm sequencing and whether Redwood can run legal redlines in parallel with DPA review? If you can propose milestone dates in a MAP, that will help our legal and procurement teams sync.

I've attached the MAP spreadsheet as a starting point and looped in Tom (legal).

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaMed
Attachments: NovaMed_MAP_v0.3.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@novamed.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novamed.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timeline for signature - Redwood pilot

On 2027-05-30 09:12, Sarah Nguyen wrote:
> Hi Karthik,
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan...

Appreciate the clear target and the MAP spreadsheet — good starting point. I've attached a compact MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf) and our suggested MSA redlines (Redwood_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf). High level sequence we recommend for an accelerated close:

- Week 0 (today - 6/03): Redwood transmits MSA redlines; NovaMed legal to confirm major liability/residency asks.
- Week 1 (6/04 - 6/07): Parallel DPA detailed review and SOC2 evidence provision. Legal and security can mark a single day for an evidence walkthrough if helpful.
- Week 2 (6/08 - 6/10): Finalize Order Form details (billing cadence, capacity, onboarding milestones) and prepare DocuSign packet.
- Target signature: 2027-06-10.

Key asks for NovaMed from Redwood: confirmation of order-form billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly), initial committed GPU pool size, and whether PO terms/transfer-of-risk clauses are mandatory for procurement.

If that timeline looks feasible, I'll set up a short cadence: daily 15m check-ins starting 6/03 through signature to triage redlines and evidence items. I can drive the DocuSign envelope once we lock the final order form; please confirm who should be listed as signatories.

Next steps: 1) Sarah/Tom — confirm SOC2 availability and preferred billing cadence for order form; 2) Laura — I'll send MSA redlines for your review (attached).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf; Redwood_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: sarah.nguyen@novamed.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-01T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + timeline for signature - Redwood pilot

Thanks — quick read through our redlines and timing notes.

Laura here (legal). A few items to flag that affect sequencing and milestone responsibilities:

- Liability cap: our standard asks are in the MSA redlines; NovaMed requested increases will require an exec-level exception. If NovaMed intends to push higher caps, please flag now.
- Data residency & DPA: DPA needs to land before we can finalize the order form for EU/APAC-bound data. For US-only workloads we can proceed on the proposed parallel track.
- SOC2 & audit artifacts: we can provide the SOC2 report and supporting attestation package by 6/03, but we need NovaMed to confirm who from legal/security will attend the evidence walkthrough.
- Procurement PO vs. DocuSign: procurement paperwork (PO) is fine post-signature but billing cadence must be fixed in the order form.

I've attached our MSA redline comments (MSA_redline_comments.pdf) — I left line notes on indemnity, termination for convenience, and a carveout for regulatory data requests. If procurement needs a PO lead time, please capture that in the OrderForm_draft_v2.xlsx.

Cc'ing Ben to coordinate commercial fallback options (billing cadence flexibility) so procurement has a clear ask.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MSA_redline_comments.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@novamed.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novamed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized runway & next actions for 6/10 target signature (NovaMed)

Sarah / Tom — thanks for the quick turn. Summarizing agreed runway and concrete owners so we can close the loop: 

Action items / owners:
- Redwood: provide SOC2 package + attestation by 2027-06-03 (Owner: Karthik / Security doc link)
- NovaMed: confirm billing cadence preference (monthly / quarterly) by 2027-06-04 (Owner: Sarah)
- Redwood Legal: finalize MSA redline responses by 2027-06-06 (Owner: Laura Bennett)
- NovaMed Legal: return DPA comments by 2027-06-04 (Owner: Tom Ellis)
- Redwood Sales Ops: finalize Order Form (billing cadence, PO number fields) by 2027-06-08 (Owner: Ben Carter)
- Both parties: DocuSign envelope prepared and circulated on 2027-06-09; target signature 2027-06-10.

Acceptance conditions for go/no-go on 6/10: SOC2 evidence available and DPA comments resolved. If high-level MSA commercial terms remain outstanding, Ben will escalate to our VP for an exception decision.

HubSpot deal: HS-5421 (link below). I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope as soon as Sarah confirms signatories and billing cadence — tentative envelope link: https://www.docusign.com/link/example-signature-session/Novamed-RWDS

Attachments enclosed for this thread: OrderForm_draft_v2.xlsx (billing cadence fields highlighted), Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf, Redwood_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m sync 6/03 to kick off triage.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrderForm_draft_v2.xlsx; Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf; Redwood_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf
